title: Proposed PublicContent projection 1.1.0
$comment: Public projection of canonical ContentPack 1.1.0, not another content format. PublicBlock and ContentVersion are unchanged copies from the registered transport schema. Resolve Recipe from the same local successor package; never fetch schema URLs.

version.description: Strict SemVer2.0 including prerelease/build; validated by exact canonical parser.

x-required-semantic-validation.source: Return only the allowlisted projection of the already validated canonical ContentPack 1.1.0. Recipes are detached field-by-field copies of that exact version.
x-required-semantic-validation.authorization: Only a current authorized learner with a current ACTIVE own Assignment to the exact organization-owned pack/version/digest may receive this payload. Managers receive no additional content-read capability.
x-required-semantic-validation.digest: contentVersion.digest binds the full canonical content, including hidden grading material and recipes, not the reduced public JSON bytes. The client checks its expected assigned pack/version/digest binding.
x-required-semantic-validation.teachingPrivacy: Never include expectedOptionIndex or feedback in PublicBlock. Recipe reference denotes only general handoff practice, never recipe-specific assessment or new learning state.
x-required-semantic-validation.strictValues: The source canonical validator enforces strict identifiers, exact 38-byte SemVer, plain text, unique IDs/options, and canonical size. Original transport definition copies alone are not sufficient semantic validation.
